bullets: Micro Hair Clinic Ljubljana is more than just a studio for scalp micropigmentation (SMP treatment).
It is a place where men and women recognize themselves in the mirror again after SMP treatment.

Our founder, SMP artist Srđan Kostovski, is among the most awarded specialists in scalp micropigmentation in Europe – but above all, he is someone who has personally experienced hair loss. And he knows what it feels like.

sections.title: Srđan's Story – SMP Artist Scalp Micropigmentation
sections.title2: Awards and Recognitions SMP Artist Srđan Kostovski – Micro Hair Clinic Ljubljana
text: "I started losing my hair early. It wasn’t an immediate shock – more a feeling that I was gradually losing a part of myself. I didn’t run from it, but I wanted a hair loss solution that wouldn’t look like a 'solution.'"

I learned about SMP (scalp micropigmentation), analyzed hair tattoo treatment results, observed every detail. And I decided – not just to perform SMP treatments, but to master the art of scalp micropigmentation to perfection."
Srđan Kostovski completed training for scalp micropigmentation (SMP artist) in Milan and opened the first SMP studio in the Balkans in 2015.
Today his SMP work is recognized across Europe, and his scalp micropigmentation technique is considered the standard for a natural hair tattoo appearance. Micro Hair Clinic Ljubljana.
